description:
As Tornado Alley expands further to the north, hurricane season is underway in the south… pulling Reed Timmer and Mike Theiss in opposite directions. But a series of missteps may allow tornadoes to escape the radar of the two storm chasing experts. As the season comes to an end, they reunite in North Dakota to chase one of the biggest storm threats of the year.
